neighbours: The linear coefficient at all ranks.
notes: A precise local inequality; its value depends on whether it holds at rank six and above, which no computation in the record tests.
observation: Its consequence at rank five is now a theorem by another route (Ferudun's certificate); at rank six nothing is computed; Ferudun's (HTE) is the general effectivity statement of which this is one local ansatz.

source.reference: Attack ktt-positivity-length-five, moves 9 to 13 (2026-09-05): the per-facet form of the discharging inequality, proved to imply the linear coefficient's nonnegativity, holding in 252,573 exact tests at rank five.

statement: For every hive polytope $H$ of any rank and every facet $F$ of $H$, with $w$ the Berline-Vergne weight (standard scalar product) of the transverse cone of an edge, $\ell$ its lattice length and $c(e)$ the number of facets containing the edge $e$: $\sum_{e\subset F} w(e)\,\ell(e)/c(e)\ge 0$.
